game_title: Syntax Sweep – Dust Devil Plain Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain, a plain of dust devils: the camel trader must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain: a plain of dust devils
core_gameplay_loop: In Dust Devil Plain, repeat each round: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the syntax_errors value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the water well using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The water well reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the water well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Syntax Sweep
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Dust Devil Plain'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how syntax_errors changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dust Devil Plain.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The water well reached with actions_used <= 18.
